faqs.question: What are your hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday-Friday 8am-8pm, Saturday 9am-5pm. Closed Sundays.

faqs.question: Do you handle emergencies?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle emergency cases during business hours. For after-hours emergencies, please call us at (555) 123-4567.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book by calling us or using the chat widget. Provide pet name, species, preferred date/time, and reason for visit.

faqs.question: Can I refill a prescription?
faqs.answer: Yes. Provide pet name, medication name, dosage, and pharmacy contact. We will process your refill request.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: Paws & Claws Animal Hospital, 123 Main Street, Springfield.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: Emergency care, wellness exams, surgery, dental care, prescriptions, and vaccinations.
